title.zh: Personal AV Instrument / 个人音画乐器

short.zh: 从个人采集的声音、图像和物件出发，制作一个可以实时演奏和控制的音画系统。
short.en: Build a realtime audiovisual instrument from personally collected sounds, images, and objects.

premise.zh: 把视觉系统当作乐器，而不是成片工具：参与者最终得到的是一套可以持续表演、改造和扩展的现场系统。
premise.en: Treat the visual system as an instrument rather than a video-making tool: the result is a live system that can keep being performed, modified, and extended.
